text:
Sam R: starting rollout for v2.9.3 (gradual) — deploy-bot set to 10% at t=0. Noting deploy-bot grace_period=120s before auto-revert. Seeing an embeddings p95 delta. Holding here until we confirm: do we manual rollback, targeted route, or wait for grace?

deploy-bot: rollout v2.9.3 -> 10% traffic. grace_period triggered: auto-revert paused for 120s. metrics to watch: p95 latency +8% (us-west-2 embeddings), errors steady.

Ben L: I can confirm the spike looks isolated to embeddings route, likely from changed batch heuristics in model handler. Core gen steady.

Elyse G: if it's only embeddings, prefer targeted rollback or route-slicing. Full rollback will cause cache cold-start and a token-cost spike. Also FYI dedicated pools can be pinned back for customers if needed.

Ana P: marketing: release note missing a mention about prompt template tweak that affects some templates. Need ~30m to update docs and customer emails. If we can keep a small slice live we can avoid a full revert.

Sam R: propose the criteria: manual rollback if (p95 > 5% across core gen) OR (error rate > 2%) OR (>=2 customer complaints). Current signal: embeddings p95 +8% but core gen unaffected and errors flat. My vote: targeted routing to send embeddings to v2.9.2, pause auto-revert, wait 10m.

Ben L: will do targeted route. patch command I'm using:
```bash
kubectl patch svc embeddings -n inference -p '{"spec":{"selector":{"version":"v2.9.2"}}}'
```
This will route embeddings to stable variant in-place.

Elyse G: agreed. I'll set threshold: if p95 rises to +12% or error rate >1.5% within next 10m, escalate to full rollback. I'll watch dashboards.

deploy-bot: note — manual intervention detected; auto-revert suspended until explicit /deploy rollback or manual unpause. To rollback fully run: `/deploy rollback v2.9.2 --reason "p95 spike" --force`

Sam R: @Ben L can you run the patch? @ops oncall please prepare rollback runbook and customer-comm draft in case we flip to full revert. :thumbsup:

Ben L: patched routing — embeddings traffic now 100% -> v2.9.2 for us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1. Verifying metrics...

Elyse G: early telemetry: embeddings p95 trending down toward baseline in us-west-2. Errors unchanged. Good sign.

ops-bot: ticket created: INC-4321 (decision log: targeted routing applied, hold auto-revert).

Ana P: marketing updated release note and doc: https://redwood-inference.internal/release/2.9.3/notes — added prompt template caveat. I'll send customer email draft to #customer-comms for review.

Sam R: filing the short incident ticket and tagging release notes checklist gap. We'll keep this thread open for 30m; if stable, we'll proceed with rollout and unpin the auto-revert. Action items: Ben verify routing stays, Elyse monitor p95/error, Ana confirm external comms. Postmortem item: add release-note propagation check to preflight.

Ben L: monitoring — no regressions seen over 6m.

Elyse G: holding threshold OK. I'll escalate immediately if we cross limits.

Sam R: thanks everyone. Closing interim decision: hold + targeted routing. Will post final state in 30m.
